newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania bomb explodes during test, kills 15.
newsitem.headline: Romania bomb explodes during test, kills 15.

text.p: A shrapnel bomb exploded on Wednesday during a test conducted at a military airfield in southern Romania, killing 15 workers and seriously injuring one other, a senior government official said.

Constantin Dudu Ionescu, State Secretary for Defence, told a government briefing in Bucharest that the experimental bomb had detonated on Wednesday afternoon at the airfield in Craiova, 235 km (140 miles) west of Bucharest.
He said the dead included eight defence industry workers and seven military engineers. "We cannot say what caused the accident, but we suspect there could have been a technical reason," he said.
Ionescu described the device as an "experimental shrapnel bomb" produced at the Mija defence plant in Ploiesti, north of Bucharest.
A plane standing on the runway was destroyed by the blast. Ionescu said one person was taken to hospital in a coma and two others suffered lesser injuries.
